title: game
description: Page-only browser game controls. Pure rules declare no state.

Controls.description: Controlled input state on a consumer-named entity. All keys, gestures and preferences live here; a remount reads the same row.

move.description: move coordinates; absent when no pointer or click

look.description: look coordinates; absent when no pointer or click

orbit.description: orbit coordinates; absent when no pointer or click

pointer.description: pointer coordinates; absent when no pointer or click

click.description: click coordinates; absent when no pointer or click

press_at.description: press_at coordinates; absent when no pointer or click

held.description: held input codes or action bindings

pressed.description: pressed input codes or action bindings

pad.description: pad input codes or action bindings

zoom.description: wheel delta since the last frame

stick.description: stick gesture state, interpreted by the browser controls

drags.description: drags gesture state, interpreted by the browser controls

mouse.description: mouse gesture state, interpreted by the browser controls
